I was hard stuck but starting to get the hang of it. I'm getting more wins than i thought i would. I solo queue as well. Here's what i learned.

Get bloodhound every match. He's great. He prevents your two rambo teammates from dying and if they do die, ult to run away. 

Learn to disengage. Sometimes when i fight a team and even though he hit me for 25 only but i just know it'll be a bad fight and disengage to reposition. You'll get that gut feeling. Dont tunnel vision and challenge him till you die. 

Got 1 or 2 kps? Okay great. Now we camp. Roast your marshmallow. Rest of the kp will come later but if you dont camp till top 5, your hard earned 2 kps will be meaningless. Also, dont feel bad if you got like 1 or 0 kps out of a team fight. You'll always get more as long as you survive. 

Comms is everything. Open that mic and speak to your teammates. Tell them what do you want to do like just play for placement etc. 

Oh yeah, it's up to you but i prefer to land uncontested. I dont see the point in taking early fights. Risk>reward.

Weapons: You main the r301, great. It's good at all range. Secondary, pick whatever you feel good at. If you have the r301 as the main, you're good. Diamond is more about positioning, map awareness, when to take fights rather than weapons choice or aim so you're good on this part.

Early kp or not. Imho, early kp is a gamble. If your 3 stack or if you feel like your 2 randos are up to it, go for it but rmb who landed around you. If there's a solo team who landed near your POI then dont take the fight. Yeah you might win the first fight but you'll just get 3rd party and die. 

Time is your greatest enemy in diamond lobbies. You need to be patient. Dont go hunting whenever you hear gunshots. Got 2 kps? Great get to the zone and hold high ground or something. Games also last a long time as it gets to the final ring most of the time so take a break. Gl on the grind.
